description: Start a Lighthouse, a11y, and link check cycle on the latest deployment. Does not publish a new deploy — use deploy for that. Then poll get_checks_results (not get_deployment_status) until scores appear. Unverified accounts skip checks on deploy; this still queues a cycle when allowed.
